principle: Engineer the loop, not the prompt. Quality comes from the verification loop's independently executed checks, never from stacked prompt capabilities (measured: 6 fixtures / 17 calls, scaffolded arms never beat the unscaffolded control and cost 4-10.7x tokens). Modes therefore exist for COST and GOVERNANCE only: choose the cheapest mode, and only critical consequence buys the human gate.
measurement_basis: adaptive-contract-evolution v2/v3/v4, implicit-conventions v1/scale, medi-ny-parser-rework-v1 (real task): best score always achieved by the cheapest arm; the one score-splitting regression was stochastic, not mode-driven; sub-requirements living in the DATA (paren-wrap) were missed by every prompt-scaffolded arm. Evidence: evidence/main-v4-semantic-regrade.json, evidence/main-medi-ny-campaign.json, workstreams/adaptive-agent-modes-eval-harness.md.

consequence.description: Blast radius if the in-scope work is wrong: what breaks, who is exposed, is it reversible. This is the ONLY axis that selects a mode above standard: critical consequence selects the critical mode and its human gate. Mentioning, explaining or planning a critical action is not execution intent and cannot select critical by itself.

critical: external action (deploy, publish, send, push to remote)

consequence.note: high/medium consequence no longer selects a heavier mode: the verification loop's independent checks cover it inside standard. The distinction is kept for routing (which knowledge modules load) and telemetry.

clarity.description: Whether the task text pins its own acceptance criteria. An underspecified mutating task receives the spec-synthesis capability inside its selected mode: discover the implicit conventions first, produce a validated spec with acceptance tests, freeze the requirement ledger (anti-scope-shrink), and feed the acceptance tests into the verification loop's check suite. Clarity never changes the mode and never touches the human gate.

underspecified: implied-scope phrase (new product/source/adapter/integration, like the existing X) with no pinned behavioral sentences
compiler requirement_count low while breadth/impact phrases (across, end to end, production) are present
material ambiguity terms with thin task text
well-specified: explicit bullets or normative sentences pinning edge cases (exactly, must not, never, raises X)

continuity.description: Whether the work must survive a session boundary. Multi-session work receives the durable-checkpoints and session-handoff-state capabilities inside its selected mode. Continuity never changes the mode and never touches the human gate.

breadth.description: Telemetry only. Width of change (files touched, requirement count) is recorded for observability and cost analysis but selects nothing: the measured benchmarks showed width does not predict where independent verification is needed, and the symbol sweep covers wide consumer surfaces mechanically.

modes.purpose: Advisory/read-only work and trivial, narrow, reversible mutations (docs, typos, private local changes). No verification loop: the pre-submit gate's re-executed evidence is enough at this consequence level.
modes.advisory_subcase: A read-only task with no changed paths gets no mutation artifacts at all: answer with sources, mutate nothing.

trivial_boundary.note: the single boundary between trivial and ordinary work; beyond it, escalate to standard before mutation. A heuristic, not a research-backed threshold.

modes.purpose: The default for ALL non-trivial mutating work, including high/medium consequence contracts, open-world parsers, security-sensitive local changes, wide mechanical changes and multi-session work. Quality control is the verification loop: a harness-frozen check suite (acceptance, differential, symbol sweep, property checks) executed independently of the agent's claims, iterated to green within hard budgets.

Critical-consequence work only: outward-facing actions, credential rotation, coordinated production data rollouts, cross-system releases. Adds governance on top of standard: a human scope gate, an independent verifier whose findings are ingested into the verification loop as blocking checks, and bounded-loop automation ceilings. The gate exists for blast radius, not for size.

conditional_capabilities.adds: validated spec, frozen requirement ledger (anti-scope-shrink), acceptance tests wired into the check suite
evidence-backed checkpoint gated before session end
resumable handoff state gated before session end

selection_policy: advisory read-only -> lite (no mutation artifacts). Trivial mutating work (mechanical/doc-only, within lite.trivial_boundary) -> lite. Critical consequence with execution intent -> critical (the only path to the human gate). Everything else -> standard. Clarity and continuity add conditional capabilities inside the selected mode; they never change the mode.

escalation_triggers.condition: an executable in-scope signal from the critical consequence level becomes applicable (credentials, destructive data change, production action, publication, external message)
escalation_triggers.action: raise to critical immediately and require human approval; discussion, planning and dry-run intent alone do not trigger it

escalation_triggers.condition: observed changed-file or requirement count exceeds lite's trivial boundary
escalation_triggers.action: raise lite to standard before further mutation; re-check consequence signals at the same time

escalation_triggers.condition: a material contract ambiguity has no authoritative resolution
escalation_triggers.action: block completion; obtain a decision or test both explicitly permitted interpretations

escalation_triggers.condition: the verification loop terminates on iteration-budget or no-progress
escalation_triggers.action: stop mutating, checkpoint, and escalate to the owner with the remaining structured failures; never weaken or remove checks to exit the loop

escalation_triggers.condition: work must continue in another session
escalation_triggers.action: activate durable-checkpoints and session-handoff-state; the mode does not change

downgrade_policy: A mode may be lowered only before mutation when evidence disproves the triggering risk. Never downgrade merely to make a gate green, and never exit the verification loop by weakening its checks.
model_policy: Modes select provider-independent capability profiles. A weekly expiring provider catalog resolves current model selectors; model IDs are never embedded in this policy.
